Novig Promo Code HANDLE: $50 Bonus for Lions vs. Panthers SNF, NFL Week 4

Register with the Novig promo code HANDLE today and snag a $50 bonus offer for Lions vs. Panthers at 8

byLee Tran
October 4, 2026, 7:05 pm EDT
in Sports

SportsHandle. Claim a $50 bonus with the Novig promo code HANDLE and trade on Lions-Panthers SNF.

Share on FacebookShare on Twitter
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:35
Instaread

Sunday Night Football sends Detroit to Charlotte for Lions vs. Panthers at Bank of America Stadium, with kickoff set for 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock. The Novig promo code HANDLE gives new traders $50 in Trade Credits after a $10 deposit, giving you five separate credits to use on Sunday night’s matchup or another NFL market.

I trade on Novig throughout the NFL season, so I’ll break down exactly how Novig promo code HANDLE works, what the $50 reward actually gives you and where I would use it on Lions vs. Panthers Sunday night.

Novig Promo Code HANDLE at a Glance

I included the essentials for Novig promo code HANDLE below so you can see the offer size, deposit requirement and platform details without digging through the full terms.

Detail Info
Novig promo code HANDLE
Welcome offer Deposit $10, get $50 in Trade Credits
Minimum deposit $10
Age requirement 21+
Platforms Web, iOS, Android
Regulator CFTC, through Ludlow Exchange LLC
Last verified October 2, 2026

How I Signed Up With Novig Promo Code HANDLE

Registration only takes a few minutes on a phone, which makes Novig one of the easier prediction market apps to get running before kickoff.

Follow these steps to claim the $50 bonus before Lions vs. Panthers starts at 8:20 p.m. ET:

  1. Download the Novig app through our link to begin registration.
  2. Enter Novig promo code HANDLE in the promo-code field when prompted.
  3. Complete the identity and location checks.
  4. Deposit at least $10 using an available payment method.
  5. Receive $50 in Trade Credits after completing the qualifying deposit.

What Do the $50 Novig Trade Credits Do?

The Novig promo code HANDLE reward arrives as five separate $10 credits rather than one $50 balance. That matters when deciding how to use them.

  • Apply one $10 Trade Credit to an eligible trade.
  • Each Trade Credit can be used on contracts priced from 1¢ through 60¢.
  • Any unused portion of an individual Trade Credit disappears, so using the full $10 at once avoids wasting value.
  • All five credits expire 30 days after they reach the account.
  • Proceeds earned from a Trade Credit position do not carry an additional trading-volume requirement before withdrawal.

That structure gives you the option to spread the bonus across five Week 4 markets rather than tying all $50 to one Lions vs. Panthers position.

Why the Novig Order Book Changes My Pricing

Novig operates as a peer-to-peer exchange rather than a traditional sportsbook, so NFL odds are determined by prices other traders are willing to accept.

The Novig promo code HANDLE credits work with either type of order:

Order type How it works What I watch
Take order Matches a price already available in the order book Available liquidity may not cover my full position
Make order Posts my own price and waits for another trader It can fill fully, partly or not at all

Posting my own number can improve the entry price on a thinner market, but it comes with a tradeoff. There is no guarantee someone takes the other side before kickoff.

My Lions vs. Panthers Prediction

Detroit visits Carolina at Bank of America Stadium on NBC and Peacock, with the Lions at 2-1 and the Panthers at 1-2.

Current Novig pricing has Detroit around 62¢ to win and Carolina around 38¢. The margin market is much tighter, with Detroit to win by 4+ around 51¢ and Carolina to win or lose by three or fewer around 50¢. The 50.5-point scoring market is also close to a coin flip.

Lions vs. Panthers Market Novig Price
Lions to win ~62¢
Panthers to win ~38¢
Lions win by 4+ ~51¢
Panthers win or lose by 3 or fewer ~50¢
51+ combined points ~51¢

Three things push my Lions vs. Panthers prediction toward 51+ combined points (~51¢):

  • Detroit has scored exactly 31 points in each of its first three games, with Jahmyr Gibbs and one of the NFL’s best rushing attacks facing a Carolina defense allowing 5.7 yards per carry.
  • Carolina is without starting cornerbacks Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson, a major problem against Amon-Ra St. Brown, Jameson Williams and Detroit’s passing game.
  • Detroit’s own pass defense has struggled, while Carolina has generated explosive completions at one of the highest rates in the league.

Detroit should score. The better question is whether Carolina can contribute enough to push the game through 50 points, and Detroit’s secondary gives Bryce Young a path to do it.

  • Lions vs. Panthers prediction: 51+ combined points (~51¢)

Final Thoughts
